webui-explorer.note: The explorer's lazy set, the assemblies the boot manifest marks lazyAssembly, which must be exactly these; measured 2026-11-19 with the Query screen; the budget that plus 5%, rounded up to 10 kB: 91,087 B to 100,000 B (ADR 0205, amended 2026-11-19, point 4; the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-20). Raising the budget or changing the set is an amendment to ADR 0205.
